channel.title: Thoroughbred Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Thoroughbred Daily News (thoroughbreddailynews.com)

item.title: Sir Mark Prescott and Bill O'Gorman Join Conversations with Emma Berry
item.description: For the latest instalment of the TDN Conversations Podcast sponsored by Saracen Horse Feeds, we are taking a step back in time to the 20th century to reflect on the careers of three extraordinary two-year-olds: Spindrifter, trained by Sir Mark Prescott, and Provideo and Timeless Times, both of whom were trained by Bill O'Gorman.

item.title: NFL Player-Turned-Horse Owner Terry Bradshaw Joins TDN Writers' Room
item.description: His fans might not know that former NFL quarterback Terry Bradshaw is also a lifelong horse lover. This year, he's hoping to get to the Breeders' Cup with his filly Taken by the Wind, the winner of the GIII Pocahontas Stakes. The enthusiastic owner joined us on this week's TDN Writers' Room.

item.title: Will Walden Joins the TDN Writers' Room
item.description: Trainer Will Walden joined this week's TDN Writers' Room to discuss his first career Grade I win with Rhetorical in the Coolmore Turf Mile.

item.title: Spendthrift's Ned Toffey Joins the TDN Writers' Room
item.description: Ned Toffey joins this week's TDN Writers' Room to discuss the stacked lineup of Spendthrift Farm-owned horses pointing for the Breeders' Cup, including the General Manager's namesake, Ted Noffey, who figures to be the favorite in the Juvenile.

item.title: Brook Smith Talks Sierra Leone on TDN Writers' Room
item.description: Horse owner Brook Smith talks Breeders' Cup-bound Sierra Leone and Schwarzenegger on the TDN Writers' Room podcast.

item.title: The TDN Writers' Room Handicaps the Breeders' Cup
item.description: The hosts of the TDN Writers' Room--Bill Finley, Randy Moss, and Zoe Cadman--offer their selections for the 2025 Breeders' Cup races.

item.title: Breeders' Cup-Winning Trainer Jose D'Angelo Joins TDN Writers' Room
item.description: Trainer Jose Francisco D'Angelo talks about his back-to-back Breeders' Cup wins with Shisospicy and Bentornato.

item.title: Damon Thayer Talks Decoupling on TDN Writers' Room
item.description: Damon Thayer provides an update on the fight against decoupling in Florida on this week's TDN Writers' Room.

item.title: Dale Romans Joins the TDN Writers' Room
item.description: Trainer Dale Romans discusses announcement that he has joined the political race for an open US Senate seat in Kentucky.

item.title: Trevor McCarthy Discusses Jockey Struggles on Writers' Room Podcast
item.description: Retired jockey Trevor McCarthy discusses the issues that caused him to retire from racing. He now advises HISA.
